judge.method: self-judged visual inspection of the Chrome render; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a main structure for a wooden fruit stall, including a counter.
requirements.note: A wooden stall with a prominent counter/display is visible.

requirements.text: Add a red and white striped canopy over the stall, supported by two vertical wooden posts.
requirements.note: The red-and-white canopy is supported by two wooden posts.

requirements.text: Display exactly four different, recognizable fruits.
requirements.note: Six fruit types are visible: oranges, apples, pears, bananas, grapes, and watermelon.

requirements.text: First fruit: A pile of red apples in a wicker basket on the left side of the counter.
requirements.note: The left basket contains oranges, while the red apples are in the center.

requirements.text: Second fruit: A bunch of yellow bananas placed next to the apples.
requirements.note: The bananas are in the lower-left basket, not next to the central apples.

requirements.text: Third fruit: A pile of oranges in another wicker basket on the right side of the counter.
requirements.note: The oranges are in the left basket; the right basket contains green fruit.

requirements.text: Fourth fruit: A single, large slice of watermelon resting directly on the counter in the center.
requirements.note: The watermelon is in a lower-right basket, not directly on the center counter.

requirements.text: Include a character representing the stall vendor, a smiling man with a mustache, positioned behind the counter and between the baskets.
Add a small, hanging chalkboard sign from the canopy that reads 'Fresh Fruit'.
requirements.note: The visible Fresh Fruit panel is neither a chalkboard nor visibly hanging from the canopy.

requirements.text: Depict a cobblestone ground surface in front of the stall.
requirements.note: The foreground has large diagonal paving lines, not a cobblestone surface.

requirements.text: Include the silhouette of another market stall in the background to suggest a larger market setting.
requirements.note: Translucent background stall silhouettes are visible on both sides.
